basic_info.description: Welcome to 1480-1490 Clay Street, a stunning property nestled in the heart of San Francisco. This expansive 9,995 square foot building boasts seven thoughtfully designed units, two of which are currently vacant and ready for your vision. Each unit offers a comfortable 3-bedroom, 1-split-bathroom layout, perfect for modern living. Situated on a 3,397 square foot lot, this gem is located in a vibrant area, with easy access to Trader Joe's, the MUNI 1 line, and the iconic cable car. Experience the perfect blend of city living and modern convenience in this fantastic location. Don't miss your chance to explore this exceptional opportunity!
